asked_by: operator 2026-10-15: open at 04:00, 07:00, 08:00/08:30 (news), each top of the hour to 11:00; avoid 09:30; power hour 15:00-16:00
population: Momentum-alert names (ai_reports/sessions/DAY/discord.jsonl.gz), counted for a window only if the name's FIRST alert of the day came before the window starts (no hindsight in who is in play). SIP 1-minute bars 04:00-20:00 from ai_reports/momentum_alerts/DAY.pkl (built by momentum_alert_markouts.py).
entry: Buy at the SIP open of the minute; exit at the SIP close 5 minutes later (primary) and 10 minutes later (information). Cost = full SIP quoted spread at the entry minute (replay_costing.entry_spread_bp). No usable spread = event dropped and counted.
w0400_note: No name has alerted before 04:00, so 04:00 cannot be tested this way; the tick replay (momentum_alert_ticks.py) reports alerts fired 04:00-04:59 as its own bucket instead.
control: Clock windows: one random minute of the same name-day within 30 minutes either side of the window start, outside the window, same hold and cost (a clock rule is not triggered by a run-up, so a two-sided control is fair). Seeded per (day, sym, window).
per_window_test: lift = window net minus control net, averaged within each day first, then across days (day-clustered t).

pass.lift: day-clustered t >= 3.0 in the predicted direction (amended_1)
pass.halves: same sign in both halves (days split at the median day)
pass.power: n >= 60 events and >= 8 days, else UNDERPOWERED
pass.worth_trading: a PASSed window is a trading candidate only if its own NET 5-min mean is > 0; a positive lift on a negative net is 'least bad', not a trade

information_only: events per day per window (opportunity count)
if_pass: pre-register a forward test of entering at that window on the live/sim desk; nothing ships from this sample alone
if_fail: time-of-day entry rules stay out of the live config

amended_1.date: 2026-10-15, before any scoring (result-skeptic NOT READY, 10 findings)
amended_1.entry: ONE entry per name per window: the first minute in the window that prints; exit = last SIP close at or before entry+4 (forward-filled inside the hold). Spread = last SIP quote 10 s into the entry minute (after the 09:30 cross).
amended_1.control: random minute AFTER the name's first alert, within 30 min of the window start, on the same side of 09:30 (premarket controls stay before 09:30, RTH controls start 09:35), outside every window. 09:30 window control = 09:35-10:04.
amended_1.power_hour: 2 random minutes per name in 15:00-15:54 after the first alert vs 2 in 13:00-14:54 after the first alert.
amended_1.pass_t: 3.0 (Bonferroni over 10 windows with ~15 day clusters); 2.5 would be expected by chance across the family.
amended_1.power: n counts name-windows (independent entries), not minutes.
amended_1.days: only days with alerts; split at the median of those; days with >5% of names missing bars are dropped and listed; OCR-outage days listed.
amended_1.quotes: quote errors are retried, never cached as 'no spread', and counted separately (quote_error vs no_nbbo); partial bar days are never cached.
amended_1.feed: all SIP; live desk is IEX and blind premarket, so a premarket PASS is tradeable only with real-time SIP.

amended_2.date: 2026-10-15, before any scoring (skeptic round 2: N1-N3 + split)
amended_2.early_alert_check: a PASS must also show lift in the predicted direction on names whose first alert came more than 30 min before the window (or before 12:30 for power hour); otherwise FAIL
amended_2.quotes: look back 2 s first, then 60 s; a 60 s request that hits the 10,000-quote limit is a quote_error, not a spread
amended_2.days: a day is dropped only when its SIP bar fetch failed (not cached); names with no bars are counted, not a reason to drop the day; the half split uses days with at least one scored pair
